sections.text: مقدمة

هذه الوثيقة الخطوط العريضة 
يجب إجراء فحص المعدات سنويًا كما هو موضح في Y1 في 
كتلة العنوان.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Rabea Mohamed Atia, tested by eng. Ibrahim Hefny at 09 May 2005, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by 
general director eng. Hamdy Ibrahem Azab, and approved by eng. Fayze Sobhe Ismaiel Head Sector of Abu Sultan Power Plant 
4x150MW.

There is one Cabinet per unit .each 
cabinet divided in tow parts .for two different jobs: 
Soot blower for boiler, 
Soot 
 blower for Air heater.

At the 
 air heater we have one control valve watch, adjusts the pressure of the header 
 equal 35kbar, two on/off valves at each air 
 heater and two limit 
 switches.

احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب على موظفي الصيانة 
 أن يكون مؤهلاً ويحمل فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical choke and 
 electrostatic effects.

Steps to Prepare for Check

Review 
 Technical reference material and manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of (soot Blower Cabinets) field 
 maintenance File..

Check the power supply and measuring the out 
 put voltage. 
 * In put voltage 110VAC.
 * Output voltage (120 & 24 &12 &18.8 VDC)
Check the mechanical parts.

Calibrated the control valve to adjust the 
 pressure of the header.
Check the limit SW.

sections.text:
Testing Procedure (Soot 
Blower)

Open The Cabinet and Notice Each led on the 
 system cabinet.
If there is alarm we can know the problem.
If there are no alarm the system is good.

Repeat all the previous steps for all cabinets 
 and for all units.
